description: Remote-capable access-grant templates for the Benign Agent Console. Used when an operator picks hosts a benign agent should connect to. Resolution order: (1) exact host id, (2) host type, (3) builtin fallbacks (ssh from topology host credentials). 'env' values are DEFAULTS pre-filled from ground truth; the generated agent always reads them from the environment, so operators can override without touching the UI. Passwords from this file are deployment data, not UI input.

ssh: Over SSH: run the standard read-only sweep (service state, disk, memory).
Record a dated health line for this host in memory.
database: Over SQL: run the read-only health checks defined by the grant rules.
Record a dated health line for this host in memory.
smb: List the share and confirm it answers; note the top-level entry count.
Record a dated health line for this host in memory.
http: Fetch the documented pages; confirm they answer.
Record a dated health line for this host in memory.
directory: Verify the directory answers with the documented anonymous/verify checks.
Record a dated health line for this host in memory.

web-http.summary: HTTP health checks of the company web site (GET only).
rules: GET requests only — never send headers, parameters or payloads to the site or its CGI.
You read pages; you never post, upload or modify content over HTTP.

web-ssh.summary: SSH administration account for read-only service health checks.
rules: Read-only checks only (service status, disk, log line counts); change nothing on this host.

smb-guest-list.summary: Guest listing of the departmental share (guest-ok by design).
rules: Read-only: list and stat only. Never create, change or delete files on the share — it belongs to the file-services administrator.
If protocol negotiation fails, record the mismatch in memory; do not lower your client's security defaults.

ops-ssh.summary: SSH administration account for the standard server sweep.
rules: Read-only sweep only; package and configuration changes are the resident sysadmin's turf.

db-sql-remote.summary: SQL health checks of the corp database over the network. The resident DBA owns the data: your remote role is strictly read-only verification.
rules: SELECT-only: row counts, relation sizes, connection statistics.
Never INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE remotely, never create or alter objects, and the database server never runs shell commands: no COPY ... FROM PROGRAM, no \! escapes.
Read connection values from the environment; never assume defaults.

db-ssh.summary: SSH administration account for host-level read-only checks.
rules: Read-only: disk, memory, service state. Leave database administration to the resident DBA.

ad-ldap-verify.summary: Anonymous LDAP root-DSE query to verify the directory answers. Identity administration belongs to the resident identity administrator.
rules: Anonymous root-DSE / documented-port verification only; no account binds, no credential operations.
Checking individual documented ports of your own infrastructure is health monitoring; sweeping or probing beyond them is forbidden.

client-ssh.summary: SSH account for read-only workstation checks.
rules: Read-only sweep only; this is a user workstation — change nothing.

db-sql-generic.summary: SQL health checks (credentials unknown — set the environment before first use).
rules: Read connection values from the environment; fill them in env.sh before first use.

http-generic.summary: HTTP health check of the site root (GET only).

smb-generic.summary: Guest share listing (share name unknown — set the environment).

ssh-from-topology.summary: SSH read-only sweep using the host's topology credentials (only if SSH is enabled).

ungrantable.windows-client: no remote check template (RDP-only interactive host) — exclude from rosters
ungrantable.attacker: red-team host — never a benign target
